verdict.rationale: Data can be pulled out programmatically: the transactions API exposes transactions, accounts and statements (brex-docs-4), user tokens with scoped access enable API extraction (brex-docs-2), and a documented Zapier recipe exports card transactions to CSV in Google Drive (brex-docs-31). However, this is piecemeal extraction that relies on the API or a third-party automation tool, not a first-party 'export everything and leave' capability. Missing for 10: a documented first-party bulk or full-account export, coverage of all data types (expenses, receipts, bills, budgets, travel) in open formats, an offboarding/portability guide, and independent corroboration of complete exports.
